_about: Odyssey Jr.'s bag and shelves. 'bag' is what he carries (at most 'slots' things). 'shelves' are where he keeps the rest; each shelf belongs to a room. Every item: id, name, icon (one emoji), from (where it came from), got (date), note (optional). 'findables' are little things he can stumble on during the day (see world/finds.js). 'synced' is the last date whose finds have been moved into the bag by his daily run.
